dedupe_keys.name: mpt svp sk flood hazard datasets

description: mpt.svp.sk: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mpt.svp.sk. Coverage: the area served by mpt.svp.sk. The listing groups 19 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PD 14,02_02 Predbežné hodnotenie povodňového rizika - potencionálne bu; PD 14,01_02 Predbežné hodnotenie povodňového rizika - pozorované udalo; PD 14,01_01 Predbežné hodnotenie povodňového rizika - pozorované udalo; PD 14,02_01 Predbežné hodnotenie povodňového rizika - potencionálne bu. Formats seen: WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply), as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
